title: [Dataset+Notebook] 16 Decks That Actually Won Real Pokémon Tournaments — Ready-to-Use deck.csv
source: kaggle CLI topic-messages + kaggle datasets download yu0307/deck-csv

messages.content_text: Shared a dataset of 16 real Japanese City League top-cut decks, already converted to this competition's own card-id format (drop-in deck.csv, no conversion needed), plus a notebook that validates legality and breaks down composition/staple cards/type distribution. Notebook: https://www.kaggle.com/code/yu0307/16-real-city-league-top-cut-decks-deck-csv. Dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/yu0307/deck-csv/data. Hope it saves someone some deck-building time.

deck_archetypes.Arboliva: Arboliva ex (310HP) + Meganium + Ogerpon ex + Fezandipiti ex; Grass; Forest of Vitality
deck_archetypes.ClefairyOgerpon: Lillie's Clefairy ex + Ogerpon ex + Iron Leaves ex + Latias ex + Mega Lopunny ex + Meowth ex; multi-type
deck_archetypes.DragapultBlaziken: Dragapult ex (320HP) + Blaziken ex (320HP) + Fezandipiti ex + Munkidori; Fire+Psychic+Water
deck_archetypes.Dragapult: Dragapult ex + Dusknoir line + Fezandipiti ex + Budew; Psychic+Water; Risky Ruins
deck_archetypes.FestivalLead: Festival Lead basics + Meowth ex + Budew; Grass; Festival Grounds
deck_archetypes.Garchomp: Cynthia's Garchomp ex (330HP) + Roserade + Spiritomb; Fighting; Risky Ruins
deck_archetypes.Grafaiai: Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex (320HP) [file mislabeled 'Grafaiai'] + Froslass + Yveltal + Tatsugiri + Budew; Darkness x9; Spikemuth Gym
deck_archetypes.Honchkrow: Team Rocket's Honchkrow + TR Murkrow + TR Articuno + TR Porygon2 + TR supporter suite; TR Energy + Ignition; TR Factory
deck_archetypes.MegaLucario: Mega Lucario ex (340HP) + Riolu + Hariyama + Lunatone/Solrock + Cornerstone Ogerpon ex; Fighting x10; Gravity Mountain
deck_archetypes.MegaSharpedo: Mega Sharpedo ex (330HP) + Carvanha + Toxtricity + Pecharunt ex + Mega Lopunny ex; Darkness x8; Gravity Mountain
deck_archetypes.MegaStarmie: Mega Starmie ex (330HP) + Staryu + Dusknoir line + Budew + Fezandipiti ex; Water+Darkness; Risky Ruins
deck_archetypes.MegaVenusaur: Mega Venusaur ex (380HP) + Bulbasaur/Ivysaur + Meganium + Ogerpon ex + Fezandipiti ex; Grass x10; Forest of Vitality
deck_archetypes.RagingBolt: Raging Bolt ex (240HP) + Ogerpon ex + Iron Leaves ex + Latias ex + Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex; Lightning+Grass+Psychic
deck_archetypes.Slowking: Slowking (120HP) + Slowpoke + Kyurem + Annihilape + Zeraora + Fezandipiti ex + Latias ex; Psychic+Water; Academy at Night
deck_archetypes.TerastalBox: Noctowl line + Fan Rotom + Pikachu ex + Ogerpon ex + Iron Leaves ex + Latias ex + Chien-Pao + Budew; multi-type
deck_archetypes.Zoroark: N's Zoroark ex (280HP) + N's Zorua + N's Darumaka/Darmanitan + N's Reshiram + N's Zekrom + Pecharunt ex + Budew; Darkness x8; N's Castle
